fontFamily.mono: var(--font-geist-mono, "Geist Mono"), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

eyebrow.fontFamily: var(--font-geist-mono, "Geist Mono"), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

descriptions.primitive.color.oat: Printed. Oat on both boards. The light page is this warm paper.
descriptions.primitive.color.beige: Printed. Beige on both boards. Warm feature-panel fill.
descriptions.primitive.color.brown: Printed. Brown on both boards. Status badge fill.
descriptions.primitive.color.forest-dark: Printed. Dark board Forest. Deep page background.
descriptions.primitive.color.surface-dark: Printed. Dark board Surface. Lifted panels on the dark page.
descriptions.primitive.color.moss-deep: Derived. Moss #47634D pulled 11% toward Forest #19382B. Small text on Sage is 4.47:1 and on Beige is 4.21:1 with Moss, short of WCAG AA 4.5:1. This step clears both (4.83:1 on Sage, 4.55:1 on Beige, 6.25:1 on Oat) and stays in the moss family.
descriptions.primitive.color.hairline-light: Derived. Forest #19382B at 18% opacity. On Oat it composites to about #CCCEC4 (~1.39:1). The boards use a soft 1px rule, not a 3:1 boundary. Button outlines use solid ink instead.
descriptions.primitive.color.hairline-dark: Derived. Sage #CAD8C5 at 24% opacity. On Forest #101E18 it composites to about #3D4B42 (~1.87:1). A visible hairline, deliberately under the 3:1 UI-boundary bar.
descriptions.primitive.radius.card: Derived. Cards, swatches, and panels are almost square, with a 2px corner.
descriptions.primitive.radius.control: Derived. Primary and secondary buttons use a small 4px radius, not a pill.
descriptions.primitive.radius.pill: Derived. The status badge is fully rounded.
descriptions.primitive.fontFamily.sans: Derived. Geist Sans for headlines and UI, by family name only. The var() slot is what next/font sets as --font-geist-sans. This package does not ship font files.
descriptions.primitive.fontFamily.mono: Derived. Geist Mono for metadata, hexes, and uppercase tracked labels.
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.display: Derived. Hero display, tight and large: "Human feel."
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.title: Derived. Card headlines such as "A little unexpected."
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.heading: Derived. Panel title "Design language / v.01" and the wordmark size.
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.body: Derived. Body and the hero lede.
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.ui: Derived. Nav links and button labels.
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.caption: Derived. Swatch names, hex codes, status label.
descriptions.primitive.fontSize.eyebrow: Derived. Mono labels such as OBJECT / 001 and 01. COLORS.
descriptions.primitive.fontWeight.medium: Derived. Display, titles, buttons. Geist Medium matches the boards better than bold.
descriptions.primitive.fontWeight.semibold: Derived. Wordmark "soft signal" is a step heavier than the panel title.
descriptions.primitive.lineHeight.display: Derived. Display lines sit tight, almost solid.
descriptions.primitive.lineHeight.title: Derived. Card headlines are tight but wrap cleanly.
descriptions.primitive.lineHeight.heading: Derived. Panel titles and the wordmark.
descriptions.primitive.lineHeight.caption: Derived. Small sans labels.
descriptions.primitive.letterSpacing.title: Derived. Card headlines are tight, a little less than display.
descriptions.primitive.letterSpacing.heading: Derived. Panel titles.
descriptions.primitive.letterSpacing.ui: Derived. Button and nav labels are nearly neutral.
descriptions.primitive.letterSpacing.normal: Derived. Body copy is not tracked.
descriptions.primitive.letterSpacing.caption: Derived. Hex codes open up slightly.
descriptions.primitive.letterSpacing.eyebrow: Derived. Uppercase mono labels are widely tracked.
descriptions.primitive.shadow.none: Derived. UI chrome on both boards is flat. The objects cast soft light, and that stays artwork, not a shadow token.
descriptions.primitive.focus.width: Derived. Focus is a 2px outline. The boards do not draw a focus ring, so this follows the accent color and clears 3:1 against the page.
descriptions.primitive.focus.offset: Derived. The offset lets the ring sit outside filled buttons, on the page color, so a forest ring stays visible on a forest button.
descriptions.semantic.light.bg: Page background. Light is the oat paper.
descriptions.semantic.light.surface: Panels and the module card. On the light board they are the same oat paper as the page; a hairline separates them, not a second fill.
descriptions.semantic.light.text-muted: Secondary text on oat: ledes, eyebrows, hex codes. Moss on Oat is 5.79:1. Do not use Moss for small text on Sage or Beige; use text-muted-accessible.
descriptions.semantic.light.text-muted-accessible: Accessible muted ink for small text on Sage and Beige. Keeps the Moss hue. Moss itself stays available as text-muted.
descriptions.semantic.light.text-on-light: Text on Beige and on the light Sage play panel. Forest on Beige is 8.11:1 and on Sage is 8.61:1. Oat on those fills fails (1.37:1 and 1.29:1) and is not used.
descriptions.semantic.light.border: 1px hairline for cards, the sidebar rule, and swatch edges.
descriptions.semantic.light.accent: Brand accent. Light uses Forest, the filled primary button.
descriptions.semantic.light.accent-contrast: Ink on the accent fill. Oat on Forest is 11.15:1.
descriptions.semantic.light.button-primary-border: Matches the fill so the primary and secondary buttons share a 1px border box.
descriptions.semantic.light.button-secondary-bg: Outlined secondary button. The page shows through.
descriptions.semantic.light.button-secondary-text: Secondary label uses the same ink as primary text.
descriptions.semantic.light.button-secondary-border: Solid Forest outline, not the hairline. Forest on Oat is 11.15:1, above the 3:1 UI-boundary bar.
descriptions.semantic.light.status-text: Status label. Oat on Brown is 4.51:1, just inside WCAG AA for normal text. The board color is kept.
descriptions.semantic.light.status-dot: The dot inside the pill. Beige on Brown is 3.28:1, above the 3:1 non-text bar.
descriptions.semantic.light.focus: Focus ring color. Forest on Oat is 11.15:1.
descriptions.semantic.light.ticker-bg: The top HUMAN FEEL / SYSTEM THINKING band.
descriptions.semantic.light.ticker-text: Ticker ink. Forest on Sage is 8.61:1.
descriptions.semantic.light.surface-warm: Feature panel. Beige in both themes, matching the warm card on both boards.
descriptions.semantic.light.surface-play: Play panel. The light board fills it with Sage.
descriptions.semantic.dark.surface: Lifted panels and the module card. Printed Surface.
descriptions.semantic.dark.text: Primary text. Oat on Forest is 14.99:1 and on Surface is 12.65:1.
descriptions.semantic.dark.text-muted: Secondary text on Forest and Surface. Sage on Forest is 11.58:1 and on Surface is 9.78:1. Sage on the Moss play panel is only 4.47:1, so eyebrows there use text (Oat, 5.79:1).
descriptions.semantic.dark.text-muted-accessible: Same accessible moss as light. Use it for small text on Beige, which stays a light fill in the dark theme.
descriptions.semantic.dark.text-on-light: Ink for the Beige feature panel in either theme. The dark board reads as light type on that beige card; Oat on Beige is 1.37:1 and fails AA. Forest is the light board's card title color and passes at 8.11:1. The failing oat-on-beige pair is recorded, not shipped as a text token.
descriptions.semantic.dark.border: 1px hairline. Sage at 24% on the dark page.
descriptions.semantic.dark.accent: Brand accent. Dark uses Sage, the filled primary button.
descriptions.semantic.dark.accent-contrast: Ink on the Sage accent. Forest on Sage is 11.58:1.
descriptions.semantic.dark.button-primary-bg: Filled primary button. Sage chip on the dark page.
descriptions.semantic.dark.button-primary-text: Label on the Sage primary button.
descriptions.semantic.dark.button-secondary-bg: Outlined secondary button. The page shows through.
descriptions.semantic.dark.button-secondary-text: Secondary label uses the same oat ink as primary text.
descriptions.semantic.dark.button-secondary-border: Solid Oat outline, the same ink as the label. Oat on Forest is 14.99:1 and on Surface is 12.65:1.
descriptions.semantic.dark.status-bg: Status pill. Same Brown as light.
descriptions.semantic.dark.status-text: Oat on Brown is 4.51:1 in both themes.
descriptions.semantic.dark.focus: Focus ring. Sage on Forest is 11.58:1.
descriptions.semantic.dark.ticker-bg: Ticker band. The dark board's strip is a quiet step above Forest, so it uses Surface.
descriptions.semantic.dark.ticker-text: Ticker ink. Sage on Surface is 9.78:1.
descriptions.semantic.dark.surface-warm: Feature panel stays Beige in the dark theme.
descriptions.semantic.dark.surface-play: Derived. The dark board does not print a play-panel hex. The panel reads as Moss #47634D, the nearest printed primitive that separates it from Surface. Oat text on Moss is 5.79:1.
descriptions.typeStyle.title: Card headlines.
descriptions.typeStyle.heading: Panel title.
descriptions.typeStyle.body: Body copy and the hero lede.
descriptions.typeStyle.caption: Swatch names and the status label.

knownFailures.label: Oat on Beige
knownFailures.note: The dark board reads as light type on the beige feature card. That pair is about 1.37:1. text-on-light keeps Forest #19382B (8.11:1), which is the light board's card title color. Oat stays the dark text token for Forest and Surface only.

knownFailures.label: Oat on Sage
knownFailures.note: About 1.29:1. The light play panel uses Forest, not Oat.

knownFailures.label: Moss on Beige
knownFailures.note: 4.21:1, short of AA for small text. text-muted stays Moss for use on Oat (5.79:1). Small text on Beige uses text-muted-accessible #425E49 (4.55:1).

knownFailures.label: Moss on Sage
knownFailures.note: 4.47:1, just under 4.5. Small text on the light play panel uses text-muted-accessible #425E49 (4.83:1).

knownFailures.label: Sage on Moss
knownFailures.note: 4.47:1. The dark play panel is Moss. Eyebrows there use text (Oat, 5.79:1), not text-muted (Sage).
